Answers are cut at 6000 characters.

tools.description: Run the tests in test/visible.test.mjs on the program in the working folder. Returns the names of the tests that passed and failed, and the first 8 lines of each failure. Answers are cut at 4000 characters.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Edit a file under src/ by replacing one exact piece of text. "find" must occur exactly once in the file (include enough of the surrounding line to make it unique); it is replaced by "replace". Only existing files under src/ can be edited. Answers are cut at 1000 characters.

path.description: Path relative to the working folder, starting with src/.

find.description: The exact text to replace; must occur exactly once.

tools.name: done
tools.description: Call this once when you have finished, with one sentence naming the step you changed. The run ends after this call. Answers are cut at 200 characters.

summary.description: One sentence naming the step you changed.

tools.name: map
tools.description: Show the program's flowchart one level deep, read from the chart in src/chart.mjs as it is now. One line per step: "address · kind · purpose". A sub-flowchart is one line; give its address to see its steps. Addresses are the step ids the run record uses. Answers are cut at 4000 characters.

address.description: Optional: a step or sub-flowchart address, for example "tax".

name: map
content:
The chart, in run order (addresses are the ids the run record uses):
receive-order · stage · Copy the incoming order into the run, one field per key.
load-customer · stage · Look up the customer and keep their limits, balance and years.
start-lines · stage · Start the line loop: first line, empty totals.
price-line · stage · Price the current line (bulk discount) and add it to the totals.
more-lines · decision (branches: next-line, lines-priced) · Decide whether another line is left to price.
  next-line · branch of more-lines, then back to price-line · Move on to the next line, then price it.
  lines-priced · branch of more-lines · Leave the line loop and note how many lines were priced.
apply-coupon · stage · Work out the coupon discount on the subtotal.
loyalty-discount · stage · Give long-standing customers their loyalty discount.
net-amount · stage · Take the discounts off the subtotal.
tax · sub-flowchart, 2 steps (ask map("tax")) · Work out the sales tax for the region the order ships to.
shipping-rule · decision (branches: free-shipping, standard-shipping) · Decide whether the order ships free or at the standard rate.
  free-shipping · branch of shipping-rule · Charge nothing for shipping.
  standard-shipping · branch of shipping-rule · Charge the base fee plus a rate per kilogram (double for express).
grand-total · stage, then in parallel: check-stock, check-credit · Add tax and shipping to the discounted amount.
  check-stock · parallel branch after grand-total · Check that the shelf holds every item in the quantity ordered.
  check-credit · parallel branch after grand-total · Check the order against the credit limit and the order limit.
combine-checks · stage · Copy the stock and credit answers to the keys the approval reads.
approval · decision (branches: hold, reject, review, approve) · Decide the outcome: hold, reject, review or approve.
  hold · branch of approval · Hold the order and name each item out of stock.
  reject · branch of approval · Refuse an order that goes over a customer limit.
  review · branch of approval · Send a large order to a person for review.
  approve · branch of approval · Mark the order approved.
